title: OTP input
summary: A one-time code or PIN as a row of cells: typing advances, Backspace steps back, a pasted or autofilled code spreads across the cells, and completion is an event.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: type
props.description: The alphabet: digits, letters and digits, or anything.

props.name: separatorAt
props.description: Puts a dash after this many cells (0 for none).

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

a11y: A role=group named by label; every cell is named "Digit n of N"; the first has one-time-code autocomplete so the OS can fill an SMS code; arrow keys, Home and End move between cells; numeric cells open the numeric keypad. Cells are 44px wide on a phone.
